fields.name: country
fields.description: Country code as used in calcbloc.com URLs and the API (lowercase, hyphenated English name or common short form, e.g. us, uk, uae, new-zealand).

fields.name: country_name
fields.description: Country name in English.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: Region code (state, province, canton, autonomous community, nation...) for regional tables; empty for national tables. Same code as the API's region parameter.

fields.name: region_name
fields.description: Region name; empty for national tables.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code of every money amount in the table (value where unit is money, and the from/to band limits).

fields.name: tax_year
fields.description: Tax year of the table: 2026 for a calendar tax year, 2026-27 for a split year (e.g. UK 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027).

fields.name: is_current_year
fields.description: true for the country's current tax year; false for an earlier year kept for reference.

fields.name: section_id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the table section the row belongs to (also the anchor on the calcbloc.com page).

fields.name: section
fields.description: Section title.

fields.name: group
fields.description: What the section covers: income-tax, employee, employer or other (see Groups).

fields.name: label
fields.description: Name of the band or value.

fields.name: from
fields.description: Bands only: lower limit of the band, in the table's currency (on the basis described in basis). Empty for value rows.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Bands only: upper limit of the band; empty means no upper limit (the top band). Empty for value rows.

fields.name: rate
fields.description: Rate as a decimal fraction (0.4 = 40%): the marginal rate of a band, or the value of a rate row. Empty for money, number and text rows.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value of a money, number or text row (see unit). Empty for bands and rate rows. Numbers are written without thousands separators.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: How to read the row: rate (see the rate column), money, number or text (see the value column).

fields.name: basis
fields.description: What the band limits or the rate apply to, and the period (per year, per month, per week). Empty when it is obvious from the label.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Qualifications or conditions for the row or its section. Often empty.

fields.name: effective_from
fields.description: First day the figure applies (ISO 8601 date).

fields.name: effective_to
fields.description: Last day the figure applies; empty means in force until changed.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Review status: verified, under_review or not_applicable (see Status values).

fields.name: source_title
fields.description: Title of the official source (government, tax authority or social security agency publication, or the law).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: URL of the official source the figure was taken from.

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.description: Date the figure was retrieved from (and checked against) source_url (ISO 8601 date).

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: The calcbloc.com page that shows this table; link here when you credit the data.
